name: Apple iPhone 12 Pro Max 512GB Gold
desc: This is a step and a leap. 5G goes Pro. The A14 Bionic leaves all other smartphone chips behind. The Pro camera system brings low-light photography to the next level – with an even bigger leap on the iPhone 12 Pro Max. And the Ceramic Shield provides four times better drop performance. Let’s see what it can do. 5G makes cellular on the iPhone faster and improves performance in congested networks. Now you can download huge files on the go or stream HDR movies in the highest video quality. Without. Annoying. Lag. The iPhone also has more 5G bands than any other smartphone, so you get 5G in more places. And this speed brings incredible possibilities for the future of apps. LiDAR technology: scans surfaces on Mars. And in the living room. NASA uses LiDAR technology for the next Mars landing. The LiDAR Scanner in the iPhone 12 Pro measures how long it takes for light to be reflected by objects. That way the scanner can create a depth map of the room you're in. Because it is ultra-fast and extremely precise, AR apps can now turn a room into a realistic rainforest or show how a sneaker fits you. The iPhone was built from the ground up for AR, and now the LiDAR Scanner in the iPhone 12 Pro takes things to a whole new level.

Many lens defects such as distortion, edge softness or vignetting occur in the outer image areas. If you use a lens designed for full frame on a camera with an APS-C sensor, those outer areas are not used. This yields maximum quality and eliminates additional post-processing time to correct lens faults.

Description

AVM FRITZ!Box 6820 LTE
Fast Internet via LTE mobile network

The FRITZ!Box 6820 LTE provides fast Internet via the mobile network and supports the wireless technologies LTE (4G) and UMTS (3G). The handy FRITZ!Box 6820 LTE is suitable for use at home and on the go, since the user is not tied to a single connection point such as DSL or cable. Fast Internet via LTE radio, short response times and powerful WLAN N with up to 450 Mbps make the FRITZ!Box 6820 LTE a powerhouse for mobile Internet.

Fast Internet at home and on the road
The device operates in nine LTE (4G) bands as well as three UMTS (3G) bands and supports roaming, so users always have Internet access—even when the FRITZ!Box is not in the radio cell of the contracted provider. The significantly improved multiband support also enables the FRITZ!Box to provide fast mobile Internet throughout Europe while traveling.

Maximum flexibility for the best reception
Depending on radio availability, the FRITZ!Box 6820 LTE switches flexibly between the LTE and UMTS networks. The design of the FRITZ!Box 6820 LTE is optimized for best reception and mobility. The housing stands upright, further improving reception performance. The handy FRITZ!Box 6820 LTE can be placed almost anywhere and is easy to transport.

Wireless convenience with top security
Fast WLAN N with up to 450 Mbps and long range enables wireless connections throughout the home network. WLAN devices such as tablets, notebooks or smartphones can be connected to the FRITZ!Box 6820 LTE easily at the push of a button (WPS). All radio connections are securely encrypted with WPA2 by default. In addition, a fast Gigabit LAN port is available for another network device. Broadband-intensive applications such as HD streaming, online gaming or video on demand can be realized at top speed.

Always up to date thanks to FRITZ!OS
AVM continuously expands the FRITZ!Box operating system — FRITZ!OS — with updates that add new functions. With the FRITZ!Box 6820 LTE, the user benefits from numerous highlights. These include the WLAN guest access, WLAN monitor, parental controls, VPN, auto-update, MyFRITZ! and more.

WLAN guest access — the secure hotspot for friends and visitors

They not only impress with perfect function, but also with the possibility of carrying out repairs in the home workshop. Even in the middle of trails, city rides or a Sunday outing, some mechanical gear issues can be solved without problems. Usually you don't need much more than a multitool. On city bikes and racing bikes manufacturers rely on these simple brakes, which makes sense: they offer decent braking power, are easy to maintain and wear slowly. The reasons are simple: flawless function, acceptable wear and easy repair. Anyone who does a little maintenance and occasionally oils the chain will have few problems. For fast tours

name: Side-pull blind LICHTBLICK ORIGINAL "Klemmfix Heat Protection" roller blinds Size 150 cm, 70 cm, white (white, white) blackout roller with thermal coating
desc: Sun protection, blackout & insulation in one: Thermo blinds from Lichtblick. The modern thermo blind "Klemmfix" with thermal coating from Lichtblick provides effective room darkening and can be mounted directly on the window effortlessly without drilling. It protects against outside views and, if desired, against too much sunlight when you don't need it — for example while sleeping. The sun protection and blackout level is 100% — ideal for bedrooms and rooms where no daylight should come in. Heat and cold protection thanks to silver coating. In addition, the high-quality roller fabric has a reflective coating on the back and thus lets no light through. This insulating thermal coating also has a positive effect on the indoor climate. In summer, incoming sunlight is reflected and your rooms heat up less. In winter, warm heated air is kept away from the cold windowpane and is therefore not unnecessarily cooled. No drilling — just clamp! Another special feature of this blind is the uncomplicated installation using the supplied adjustable clamp brackets. The thermo blind is simply and quickly clamped directly to the window sash with the clamp holders. No holes need to be drilled and no additional tools are required. Especially in rental apartments, holes in the wall or even the window frame pose a major problem. Those times are over, because with the clamp bracket installation there is no need to drill or screw. If desired, the blind can of course also be mounted to the wall or ceiling using the included accessories. Thanks to chain drive and chain holder: simple & secure operation. The height-lockable Klemmfix thermo blind with thermal coating from Lichtblick offers a great combination of high functionality and attractive design, and can be fitted to any window in no time without drilling to create appealing color accents. It is operated by an endless chain which can be mounted on the left or right. The advantage of side-pull operation is that it is virtually maintenance-free, infinitely adjustable up and down, long-lasting and very easy to operate even for larger blinds. The fabric feed (winding/unwinding of the blind fabric) can be set in two ways: towards the room or towards the window. To change the fabric feed, simply unwind the fabric completely from the tube and rewind it in the opposite direction. The fabric is wipeable, UV- and moisture-resistant and also colorfast.

About the author and other contributors Susanne Gernhäuser, born in Nuremberg in 1966, studied history and German studies at the University of Stuttgart. Melanie Brockamp studied communication design at the University of Applied Sciences in Hanover. She painted as a child and wanted to become a set designer or illustrator.
